title: Season match counts depend on CSV load order due to competition/season de-dup
evidence: loader.go:103-123 skips any match whose competitionSeasonKey is already `covered[]` by an earlier file, so overlapping Serie A/Copa do Brasil seasons in novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv and BR-Football-Dataset.csv are dropped wholesale rather than merged; a season's totals reflect only the first file that supplied it.
suggestion: Document the precedence or merge per-fixture across files instead of excluding whole competition/season pairs.

title: standings output always labelled 'Final Standings' even for in-progress or partial seasons
evidence: tools.go:290 prints '%d %s Final Standings (calculated from matches)' unconditionally, regardless of how many rounds the dataset holds for that season.
suggestion: Drop 'Final' or qualify it (e.g. 'Standings from N matches').

title: biggest_wins accepts an empty filter and ranks across all competitions/seasons
evidence: tools.go:314-326 builds a MatchFilter with no required field; with no args it computes BiggestWins over every loaded match (matches.go:273), mixing Serie A, cup and Libertadores results.
suggestion: Optional: require a competition or season, or label the competition of each listed match (it is already shown in the match line).

title: MCP protocol, all seven tools, and spec example queries are covered by BDD-style tests
evidence: mcp_test.go exercises initialize/tools/list/tools/call, error paths and the Corinthians-2022, Fla-Flu head-to-head, 2019 standings and player-by-club spec examples; 14 test functions / 87 subtests, test_coverage=0.854 (scores.json).
suggestion: None — noted as a strength for cross-run comparison.
